title: MAGIC RIDE
lines: Magic ride is a data center in orbit.
It keeps 950 shots from 144 films. Every film is a tower, every shot a floor, every frame a window.
Its 6 streets are the scenes of the poem, in order: the first is “Ex dissolves into haze”.
The tallest tower is RCA 16mm Sound Projector, The (1958): 36 floors.
Nothing in it is older than 1915 or newer than 2015.
The sign most often read here is index of lack.
